issue.title: bob-mac-capture lint rejects newline-bearing raw strings in CaptureTogglePresentationTests
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `Tests/CaptureCoreTests/CaptureTogglePresentationTests.swift:512,576,588`

bob-mac-capture CI job `macOS 26 SwiftPM` / `Lint Swift formatting` fails while parsing `Tests/CaptureCoreTests/CaptureTogglePresentationTests.swift`. The only errors on SHA `7b87f7926cd739ad738d7c4f2b88197811cd9b9e` (run https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/38419021175) are:

- line 512: `expected '"#' to end string literal` (and the ternary/pattern cascade on 513)
- line 576: same, then `unexpected code in switch case` on 577
- line 588: same, then `unexpected code in switch case` on 589

Those three sites open a dropped-dependencies JSON fixture with a single-line raw string `#" ... "#` that contains newlines. Swift allows newlines only in a multiline raw string (`#""" ... """#`). The `guard` → `linkGuard` rename in `CaptureLinkGuardPresentation.swift` and `CaptureModelTests.swift` is already clean: this run reports no errors in those files.

The same file failed lint on `8f89423` (run 38408350959), `a86eddb` (run 38414162582), and `6345673` (run 38417330907) before this rewrite. Proposed by bob-cli-7d.3 note #1 and bob-cli-7d.4 note #3. bob-cli-7b treated the compile break as its own remaining work, landed `7b87f79`, and closed; the run above is still red. Not caused by the Go To commits: their files contribute zero `error:` lines.

Fix: rewrite the three fixtures as multiline raw strings and re-run the macOS SwiftPM lint job.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Parser errors, not a flake. Run 38419021175 is the only job on 7b87f79 and it fails at Swift parse time on the same three lines every time. The identical file also failed lint on 8f89423, a86eddb, and 6345673. There is no passing rerun on 7b87f79.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-7d.3 and bob-cli-7d.4 proposed this pre-existing Mac CI lint failure. bob-cli-7b rewrote the fixtures as single-line raw strings and closed, but CI run 38419021175 on 7b87f79 is still red on the same three sites, and no task bead tracks the remaining failure.
